problem: The head term is written as plain text '243/4' instead of 24 to the power 3/4. Read literally, 243/4 = 60.75, which does not match the 10.84 shown next, so the working looks self-contradictory and a student may copy the wrong exponent.
fix: Write Ns = 1450 × √0.035 ÷ 24^(3/4) = 1450 × 0.1871 ÷ 10.84 ≈ 25.0 (use a superscript for the exponent 3/4, as in Section 3).
